up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL2243 (Fatty-acid amide hydrolase 1). The query must join activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_structures, and molecule_dictionary. Filter for: (1) target CHEMBL ID 'CHEMBL2243', (2) assay standard type 'IC50', (3) standard relation '=', (4) non-null pChEMBL values. Return columns: assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Order by molecule_chembl_id ASC, then assay_chembl_id ASC. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type AS target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id AS tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, activities.standard_type AS standard_type, activities.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2243' AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000
